summary_en: Year-end dividend raised from ¥7.00 to ¥10.00 per share for FY2026.12, reflecting improved consolidated earnings guidance (net income up 27.0% to ¥367M, EPS up to ¥45.31). First increase since dividend reinstatement in FY2016.12.
title_en: Notification regarding modification of full-year consolidated earnings forecast (upward revision) and modification of dividend forecast (dividend increase) for FY2026
translation_en_brief: Fuji Seiki has raised its full-year dividend forecast for FY2026.12 (year ending December 31, 2026) from ¥7.00 to ¥10.00 per share, effective at the year end. This increase is driven by an upward revision to consolidated earnings: operating profit revised up ¥136M (27.5%), net income up ¥78M (27.0%) to ¥367M, with EPS rising to ¥45.31 from prior guidance of ¥35.78. The company attributes the improvement to cost-rate gains in precision tooling and precision molding operations, offset partly by lower sales in the tooling segment and increased SG&A. The company states that stable orders in Japan and China precision tooling, combined with steady demand in Southeast Asia automotive-related precision molded components, support the higher payout. This marks the first increase since the company resumed dividends in FY2016.12 following the Indonesian subsidiary's profitability turnaround after three years of operation.
